title: PANDA – Paired Anti-hate Narratives Dataset from Asia: Using an LLM-as-a-Judge to Create the First Chinese Counterspeech Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Sourcing explicitly sexist comments from the SWSR dataset to curate a balanced hate speech corpus, and evaluating the quality of LLM-generated Chinese counterspeech using simulated annealing, human annotation, and an LLM-as-a-Judge.

Filtering open-source Chinese hate speech datasets (COLD, CHSD) for targeted attacks on groups based on race and ethnicity, then evaluating the relevance and effectiveness of generated counter-narratives.

Identifying hateful statements based on national origin (e.g., discriminatory remarks against Russian individuals) within the source datasets and assessing how well humans and LLMs generate mitigating counterspeech.

Conducting one-tailed t-tests to compare JudgeLM's rankings of human-preferred counterspeech versus AI-generated counterspeech, measuring the model's systematic bias toward AI stylistic flourishes and superficial alignment over human-crafted logical rebuttals.
